consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: audit finding - change assurance not applied to TX-3001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on TX-3001 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically switching, racking and access authorisation. TX-3001 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during cleaning and preparation while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity had degraded below its design intent. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 8 June 2026 a planned assurance activity of TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility found the earth leakage and protection setting integrity not effective.
